title: dalbergia ovalis
intro: Dalbergia ovalis, commonly known as Philippine rosewood, is a type of tropical tree native to the Philippines. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal effects, which can aid in reducing fever, pain, and infection. The therapeutic actions of Dalbergia ovalis include its use as an analgesic, expectorant, and antipyretic, making it a potential treatment for various ailments such as coughs, colds, and fever. The bioactive constituents of Dalbergia ovalis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
